title: Production service unavailable
recommended_action: Check service health, recent deployments, infrastructure dependencies, logs, and rollback readiness. Escalate immediately when production access is blocked for multiple users.

title: User authentication failure
recommended_action: Verify identity-provider availability, token expiration, user permissions, recent authentication changes, and account lockout status.

title: Billing or payment issue
recommended_action: Validate the invoice or transaction record, confirm payment-provider status, review account entitlements, and route refund requests for authorized human review.

title: Potential security incident
recommended_action: Do not attempt automated remediation. Preserve evidence, restrict exposure when authorized, and immediately escalate to the security incident response team.

title: Missing, duplicate, or incorrect data
recommended_action: Identify the affected records and source system, validate recent pipeline executions, compare source and destination counts, and avoid destructive corrections without approval.

title: Feature or enhancement request
recommended_action: Capture the business problem, expected outcome, affected users, urgency, and acceptance criteria before routing the request to product review.

title: General support investigation
recommended_action: Collect reproducible steps, timestamps, affected users, screenshots or logs, environment details, and the expected versus actual behavior.
